scope: Self Hosted RAW removal relocation: unconfirmed catalogue commits and passive discover startup/directory/event recovery
host: macOS, Bun 1.4.3-canary.1; real temporary filesystem and SQLite databases
implementation: Once the verified destination reaches the identity hook, an error retains both complete edits and the durable journal because the catalogue may already have committed
Discovery inspects journals before partitioning supported files, re-lists after recovery, and excludes blocked photos from both new and missing candidates
The shared discover event handler recovers before hash/catalogue mutation, including direct created/removed/rename producers
Complete verified publications survive; partial replacements restore their previous pair only with intact retained incoming source evidence
Busy, corrupt, changed and unsafe-source evidence defers the affected primary while other photos continue indexing
Passive recovery restricts existing source coordination files to canonical registered library roots, including cross-library sources
Discover stop joins active recovery/catalogue work before database shutdown
A failed post-recovery directory read emits no catalogue changes from the stale listing and retries on a later sweep
qualified: Real relocateAsset and real SQLite transaction: failure before commit, lost acknowledgement after commit, later destination sidecar after committed update
Byte-preserved RAW/XMP and exact native RGB exports at the source and retained destination; valid catalogue address after committed acknowledgement failure
Actual SIGKILL of live source/destination/XMP lease owner at prepared, partial and completed production publication
Production startDiscover resumes generation 3 from persisted SQLite checkpoint/frontier and settles recovery before stop returns
Complete recovered destination deduplicates onto the source asset's actual content identity
Partial replacement restores the previous RAW/XMP before hashing or adding a destination catalogue row
Active owner blocks direct events and sweep indexing for its primary; another photo continues; later SIGKILL permits recovery on the next visit
Absent primary with damaged journal does not acquire a missing-location tag
Create-only partial primary is removed before the supported-file partition
Complete publication recovers with missing source directory
Intact source in a different registered library is accepted; unregistered source cannot acquire new coordination files
Unreadable post-recovery listing defers catalogue writes without terminating the sweep
